description_en: Retrieves the details of a task
kebab_example: aliyun emas-appmonitor get-tlog-task-info --app-key 233588686 --os android --task-id WXAIGCOYIQELGKLAL6IFXECD4B --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetTlogTaskInfo

parameters.help_en:
The OS type. Valid values:
iphoneos
android
parameters.name: os

Model.description_en:
id String The task record ID, which is usually the same as taskId.
taskId String The remote log task ID.
taskName String The task name.
appKey String The AppKey of the application.
appId String The application identifier, typically in the format `<appKey>@<os>`.
taskType String The task type. For remote log scenarios, this is typically REMOTE_LOG.
sourceType String The task source type. For example, USER indicates that the task was initiated by a user.
mode String The task mode. For example, ACTIVE.
status String The task status. For example, NORMAL.
reason Object The information about the reason for initiating the task.
reason.description String The description of the reason. For example, logs from the most recent days calculated from the initiation time.
reason.type String The reason type. For example, USER.
templateConfig String The task template configuration in JSON string format, which includes settings such as the number of days for log retrieval, deadline, and network restrictions.
collectionNums Long The total number of target collection devices or collection records for the task.
successNums Long The number of successful collections.
failNums Long The number of failed collections.
fileNums Long The number of generated log files.
progress String The task progress, typically in the format successNums/failNums/collectionNums/fileNums.
dayNum Integer The number of days for log retrieval.
author String The user who initiated the task.
authorEmpId String The employee ID of the user who initiated the task.
authorParentEmpId String The employee ID of the parent or organization associated with the user who initiated the task.
createTime Long The task creation time as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
modifyTime Long The last update time of the task as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
firstTime Long Response time of the first collection completion or first response. A value of 0 indicates that this has not yet occurred.
succeededTime Long Response time when the task was successfully completed. A value of 0 indicates that the task has not yet been completed successfully.
notifySetting Object The notification settings for the task.
notifySetting.completed Boolean Specifies whether to send a notification when the task is completed.
notifySetting.notifyEmail Boolean Specifies whether to enable email notifications.
notifySetting.notifyPhone Boolean Specifies whether to enable phone notifications.
notifySetting.notifyWebhook Boolean Specifies whether to enable webhook notifications.
notifySetting.first Boolean Specifies whether to send a notification upon the first collection or first completion
Model.description_zh:
id String 任务记录 ID，通常与 taskId 一致
taskId String 远程日志任务 ID
taskName String 任务名称
appKey String 应用 AppKey
appId String 应用标识，通常格式为 `<appKey>@<os>`
taskType String 任务类型，远程日志场景通常为 REMOTE_LOG
sourceType String 任务来源类型，例如 USER 表示用户发起
mode String 任务模式，例如 ACTIVE
status String 任务状态，例如 NORMAL
reason Object 任务发起原因信息
reason.description String 发起原因描述，例如按发起时间计算最近几天的日志
reason.type String 发起原因类型，例如 USER
templateConfig String 任务模板配置，JSON 字符串格式，包含回捞天数、截止时间、网络限制等配置
collectionNums Long 任务目标采集设备数或采集记录总数
successNums Long 采集成功数量
failNums Long 采集失败数量
fileNums Long 已生成的日志文件数量
progress String 任务进度，格式通常为 successNums/failNums/collectionNums/fileNums
dayNum Integer 回捞日志天数
author String 任务发起人
authorEmpId String 任务发起人员工 ID
authorParentEmpId String 任务发起人所属上级或组织相关员工 ID
createTime Long 任务创建时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳
modifyTime Long 任务最后更新时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳
firstTime Long 首次采集完成或首次响应时间，为 0 时表示尚未发生
succeededTime Long 任务成功完成时间，为 0 时表示尚未成功完成
notifySetting Object 任务通知配置
notifySetting.completed Boolean 是否在任务完成时通知
notifySetting.notifyEmail Boolean 是否开启邮件通知
notifySetting.notifyPhone Boolean 是否开启电话通知
notifySetting.notifyWebhook Boolean 是否开启 Webhook 通知
notifySetting.first Boolean 是否首次采集或首次完成时通知
